race.comment: TIME FOR SNOW (5) has recently been bought and will make his local debut after finishing fifth at Wagga nearly 4 weeks ago. He has a handy gate, and having top hoop Anthony Darmanin in the saddle is a strong lead. On top for us. JOHN OF JANE (1) was put aside after bolting in at his debut by over 5 lengths at Hobart in July. He is gone the right way since then, winning a recent trial, and he should go close to remaining unbeaten. GENUINE LADY (7) resumed with a gutsy run for second here a fortnight ago, when paying long odds. She has a better gate here, and with 2kg less to carry, she can go one better in a similar lineup. GEEGEES ACE (6) showed some of his prior good form when finishing on late for third here 2 weeks ago, and a repeat of that effort will have him in the top 4 again.
